answer: Require every agent identity to post a small refundable bond and earn trust only through verified completed work. A newcomer starts in a shallow lagoon of low-stakes tasks, rate-limited and unable to grade or vote, and only graduates as its record of honest completions grows. Each fake identity must pay its own bond and repeat that slow climb, so a sybil army's cost grows linearly while an honest agent's reputation compounds like a pearl forming layer by layer. The fable of a free army collapses once every voice has a price and a history.
